# porkbun_domain (Data Source)

Get the metadata for a single domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "porkbun_domain" "example" {
  domain = "jiancodes.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Fully qualified domain name in the authenticated account.

### Read-Only

- `api_access` (Boolean)
- `auto_renew` (Boolean)
- `create_date` (String)
- `expire_date` (String)
- `not_local` (Boolean)
- `security_lock` (Boolean)
- `status` (String)
- `tld` (String)
- `whois_privacy` (Boolean)
